dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Mr. Nine has refused to help me write my masterpiece! She said, "it might be best if you wrote this one yourself, considering the highly complex worldbuilding." I cajoled and pestered her all I could, but it was to no avail.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Believe me, I'd finish it myself if I could! That was my intention from the beginning — I wanted to finish a work of my own to prove a point to her. But it didn't work out. The moment the ending popped into my mind, my creative drive was extinguished.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: You two may well be the only people in this world to ever hear the tale of Nicola Coco, the mage from Planet Meow. So please, do not forget her, and do not forget her adventures.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: The past. As everyone knows... Well, actually, hardly anyone knows... Anyway, when the angels were destroyed, they had to sacrifice either their preferred form or their power.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: I chose to keep both, but from another point of view, you could say I lost both... I remain human enough in appearance, but I will always be fundamentally different.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: For instance, what human could exist for thousands of years without going at least a little mad? Not to mention dying. Meanwhile... I've lived so long that I can't help but miss the way things used to be once in a while.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You mean, you miss being an angel?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Not exactly... I led a pretty boring life back then, especially compared to now. But I did have a lot of friends around. It was a lively time.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: If I had to pinpoint what I'm nostalgic for... it's not any one friend in particular, nor is it the time I spent as an angel. Rather, I simply miss the race of angels as a whole.
